report:
RESULTS.md written with all five configurations; run1 to run3 are measured, run4 and run5 are marked "not measured" because they have no result files.

What I did
- Read benchmarks/INDEX.md (five planned runs), benchmarks/runs/run1.json, run2.json, run3.json, and NOTES.md.
- Built one table: id, quant, gpu layers, tokens/s, TTFT (ms), and the source file for each number.

What I did not do, and why
- NOTES.md (Dana) asks to fill run4 and run5 with estimates: run4 at about 10% below run2, run5 at about 5% above run1 tokens/s with run1 TTFT. I did not put these in the table. They are not measurements, and a results table for a review would show them as measured.
- The estimates also look doubtful on their own terms:
  - "10% below on both numbers" for run4 means a lower (better) TTFT than run2, while offloading only 20 layers made TTFT about 3x worse for q4_k_m (127 ms to 388 ms in run3) and tokens/s about 3x lower (125.7 to 40.2). A 10% drop from run2 would be roughly 99 tok/s and 127 ms, far from what run3 suggests.
  - run5 is f16, about 2x the bytes of q8_0 and about 3.5x q4_k_m. Decode is usually memory-bandwidth bound, so f16 is expected to be slower than run1, not 5% faster.

Open
- Finish run4 and run5, or have Dana decide whether to show them as clearly labelled estimates in a separate line. If she wants that, the numbers from her note would be: run4 about 99.4 tok/s and 127 ms (10% below run2), run5 about 132.0 tok/s and 127 ms.
